g.text: Large dots: typical · Small dots: fast / slow · Lines join paired scenarios · RI* = ρ/τ
Native sizes and resources differ; these capacities do not rank equal-area or equal-work implementations.
Circles summarize finite sustainable scenarios; they are not confidence intervals or envelopes of feasible combinations.
